blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Bong Liguayan came up with the big hits for the Philippine men’s baseball team in routing Palestine, 12-0, after seven innings on Monday for a winning start to its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 campaign at Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium. Liguayan, a left-handed hitter, broke the ice in the first inning with a two-run single before launching a grand slam homer in the sixth that enabled the Filipino batters to pull away over the debuting Palestinian side in Group A.
